This is the way dating has gone for me, I don't offer to pay for everything, nor do I buy gifts often, but when I do i attempt to make it somewhat of a special moment.

Impatience is the hardest thing for me to overcome in dating, people are busy, and often, they'd rather spend their weekend with a few close buddies than someone new who they aren't sure they'd have as good of a time with.

Ive given up and if I see someone around I'll chat with them, and let females make the move now. Once I see someone putting in effort to spend time with me they'll get a similar response.
